author: lgmatias
body:
Hey! I've been working this map for a while now, and I thought since I just recently got it near done, now might be a good time to release it and see what you guys have to say.

First off, this map contains two objectives, one for each team, which are located in the two large trees directly out of spawn. Each team's spawn is in a cabin, loaded with a few chests of TNT and cannoning supplies. Iron can be found under and inside the trees of the surrounding forested area, but that area quickly transitions into a dusty and dry sand covered frontline. 

I wanted elevation to be a big part of the map so I made two very large mountains left and right of the tree which contain double chests with more TNT supplies and two diamond chest plates per chest. These supplies are heavily susceptible to cannon fire however, and with the cannoning platforms built into the mountain, it becomes very easy to remove this advantage from the other team. These chests do not contain all the TNT supplies, and do not cripple the team if destroyed, but contain valuable resources that could give your team the upper hand. The frontlines are laced with some TNT to make another cannoning target early on.

As for sky bridge, there are many prebuilt shafts in the mountain to start sky bridge and these nooks even contain extra blocks from which to start said bridge. This was created to give multiple possible locations to start a bridge, each possibly warranting their own advantages and disadvantages.

I haven't tested it much yet, but I'm looking to get some feedback from the community on what I can add or change to make it better. If you have any suggestions, I'd love to hear them! Thanks!
Album: http://imgur.com/a/uvyKU

Packaged Download (With YML): http://bit.ly/1E25laM

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: Tinkered around with the TNT a bit, and unfortunately dirt is kind of a poor material to use when dealing with TNT. Defenses will be too overpowered, teamgrief will dominate the map, and there's no fallback under the dirt such as bedrock to counter anything. If you have 1 griefer, it could kill the entire map since dirt is so sensitive. I recommend adding a layer of bedrock or something underneath the 3rd dirt layer instead, or changing the dirt material entirely. I also updated a few things (missing blocks, and spawnkit chest). Thanks for the submission though, I'm liking it so far.
